paragraphs: R' Yaakov bar Ada bar Atalyai; Gittin, chapter 1, halakhah 2.[^1][^2]

notes.text: פ״ח-ז gives Ezra 8:7; פ״א ה״ב gives Gittin chapter 1 halakhah 2, suggesting Jerusalem Talmud without an explicit corpus or independently checked edition. Earlier machine גימין/א differs from the supplied locator text.
Atalyai and biblical Atalyah remain distinct forms and attestations. Both bar links preserve the three-generation chain; only Yaakov has an abbreviated title, retained as R'.
